classification.resume: This is a 2-minute segment of the Swiss TV news program Tagesschau from January 28, 2003, reporting on Israeli Arabs facing a difficult election. It includes a live duplex from Davos with Antonio Antoniazzi covering the 33rd World Economic Forum. The segment is part of the daily news broadcast produced by Schweizer Fernsehen DRS.
